text:
[LTIM.8.1.2] Temporal-to-string, members of `Time` and `Date`
([LGRA.9.6.2]) naming a format from [LTIM.8.2]:

```
t.to_string(format: String) → String
d.to_string(format: String) → String
```

The ISO-8601 form and the `Duration` compact form are written by the casts
`t::String`, `d::String` and `dur::String` instead ([LCST.4.5.9]).
